limitations: No local Xcode project build, simulator, physical-device runtime, signing, archive, installation or distribution was performed for this source snapshot.

The lifecycle executable uses the production store with synthetic injected transport/credentials and real temporary files; it does not exercise device Keychain, iPhone networking, browser sign-in or the deployed hosted service.
Static typechecking does not validate rendered SwiftUI behavior, VoiceOver, keyboard/PDF-picker presentation, project resource packaging, entitlements or device file-protection behavior.
No live employer application submission occurred.
CareerResearch.json and the project file are captured for source identity; swiftc does not validate project packaging.

Both Xcode configurations request Career Finder for CFBundleDisplayName and CFBundleName, and the project source parses. The generated app Info.plist and external App Store/TestFlight display metadata require the publisher's exact-build verification.

hostedIntegration.defaultScope: Setup presentation only; existing saved service origins are never replaced.
hostedIntegration.continuation: Authenticated POST /api/apply/advance with {planId}; fresh workspace GET required before and after.

priorHostedBuild.scope: Earlier published candidate only; does not establish a linked build for subsequent source changes.

verificationScope: iPhone hosted connection, general-audience branding, fresh profiles and legacy record compatibility

generalAudienceAudit.freshApplicantDefaults: Blank name, contact, location, profession, personal URL and CV; career stage unspecified and all work modes available.
generalAudienceAudit.freshPlanningDefaults: Blank biography, target country/city/role, planning currency and salary floor; display zone follows device.
generalAudienceAudit.freshHistory: No saved jobs, statuses, snapshots, preparation steps, application records or bundled current recommendations.
generalAudienceAudit.legacyRecordPolicy: Existing real saved records and compatibility storage/identity keys are preserved; archival fallback is loaded only for existing saved/tracked identifiers.
generalAudienceAudit.salaryScreen: Blank general calculator first; historical Saudi examples retained in an optional disclosure.
generalAudienceAudit.discoveryLimit: Six selected Saudi-oriented employer sources and selected role families; no worldwide discovery coverage claim.
